product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to match professionals with paid opportunities and help investment firms, consultancies, enterprises and AI labs find and engage human experts.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is available for the Ethos Evals product.

named_customers.notes: Listed under “Companies hiring with Ethos” on its recruiting product page.

employee_band.notes: Public headcount sources conflict and do not establish one of the permitted employee bands reliably.

eng_blog.notes: No readable blog index or two engineer-authored technical build posts could be verified.

public_docs.notes: Ethos Evals has public developer documentation covering authentication, workflows, tool reference and benchmark catalogue; running evaluations requires an invited account.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The corporate AI Engineer and RL Engineer postings were closed; no comprehensive current corporate vacancy list could be verified, so an affirmative or company-wide negative cannot be established.

model_provider.value: Anthropic; OpenAI; Google (Gemini); Groq; OpenRouter; Cartesia; Deepgram; ElevenLabs
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list identifies AI/language-processing providers, a model gateway, and voice-agent speech providers; it does not specify exact model versions.

compliance_certs.notes: The DPA claims UK GDPR and applicable EU GDPR compliance, not a GDPR certificate. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are not counted: the compliance-lead posting describes taking the programme from early setup to certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The May 6, 2026 Series A falls within the 18 months ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No current corporate SDR, BDR or account-executive opening was verified. Searchable account-executive opportunities were expert assignments for client AI training, not Ethos corporate sales roles; no complete corporate vacancy list was available.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest verifiable dated product-launch item found was the March 23, 2026 platform announcement, before May 9, 2026. Ethos Evals is publicly available in invite-only beta, but its launch date could not be verified.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level appointment or departure was verified, and no complete, checkable leadership roster was available.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The official subprocessor list identifies these as sales intelligence, lead generation, email discovery/verification, messaging or email-delivery services; it does not name a CRM of record.
